name: vinyl-player
title: Vinyl Player
description: A music card whose cover is a record half out of its sleeve, spinning while it plays and coasting to a stop.

perf.budget: While playing, the record turns with one repeating UI-thread timing and the progress with another; the time re-renders four times a second. Paused, nothing animates.

a11y.reducedMotion: The record does not spin or drop in; controls change state without the ring flash or icon pop.
a11y.screenReader: Title and artist read as one line; the progress is adjustable in ten-second steps; Mute is a switch; Previous, Play/Pause and Next are buttons.
a11y.touchTarget: Controls and the mute switch are 48 pt; the progress bar's touch area is 44 pt tall.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add vinyl-player`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
